payload.author: mriynick
payload.story_text:
hey hn
we're building mriya (a ukrainian social network that's basically facebook but with zero censorship, retro design, full freedom of speech and we don't give a shit about dmca) project's been alive for a while already, but the site is still getting rebuilt right now. you can already register and poke around -it's in open beta. official public launch is planned for early november.if you want to follow the progress (whether you're american or from anywhere else) jump into the telegram via this redirect: https://t.me/mri_redirect
site: https://mriya.ink
would love to hear what you think, especially the harsh feedback
payload.title: Mriya Ukraine's uncensored Facebook alternative (open beta)
